purpose: Record a reproducible upstream candidate for improving Krea2 detail and img2img quality without weakening the fixed six-LoRA Albina production contract.

upstream.license: Modified CC BY-NC 4.0 dual license; attribution required; no code redistribution without attribution.
upstream.sourceStatus: upstream source inspected remotely; no local install or vendoring performed

candidateCapabilities: native Krea2Pipeline img2img through VAE init latent
three-stage progressive refinement with per-stage sampler and schedule
Krea2 Qwen3-VL Vision Prompt for semantic image grounding
reference-latent edit pathway that requires a compatible edit LoRA
2x upscale VAE decode with native-size Lanczos downsample quality pass
fixed-seed bounded parameter sweeps with per-cell recipe receipts

verifiedLocalCompatibility.conclusion: The candidate cannot run in the current ComfyUI Python environment until diffusers and transformers are upgraded and the Krea2 Raw/Turbo diffusers-layout weights are verified.

productionBoundary.fixedStyleLoraChain: must remain in the existing six-LORA order and strengths
productionBoundary.canonicalGeometryAuthority: must remain canonical RGBA; this candidate may improve RGB material/detail only
productionBoundary.forbiddenInference: A candidate render is never proof of character fidelity or promotion readiness.
productionBoundary.acceptance: Install only into the existing ComfyUI environment after dependency and weight checks. Run one fixed-seed Albina unarmored anchor with a full receipt and direct original-resolution image review before any batch work.

decision.reason: It is the only located Krea2-specific open implementation that exposes native multi-stage img2img, vision grounding, solver/schedule control, and a downsampled upscale decode quality pass in one reproducible workflow.
decision.notYetAuthorizedAsBaseline: No installation, dependency upgrade, model download, or production asset generation has been performed by this research record.

existingCanonicalLatentAnchor.finding: Canonical silhouette and alpha are retained, but the generated RGB pass remains soft and does not separate the authored mechanical hard-surface detail sufficiently for a release portrait.
existingCanonicalLatentAnchor.allowedUse: failure comparison only; not a promoted asset and not a batch-production anchor
